decision: Stop this local research allocation with a supported directional result: the fixed compact student regime has not retained enough teacher speaker distinctions to justify selecting either student for integration, and the matched KD setting provides no demonstrated advantage over GT-only. Retain GT-only as the experimental control, not as a deployment selection. Do not allocate automatic extra seeds, thresholds, architectures or training from these results.
issue_state: OPEN; no issue mutation or publication performed
why_stop: Both learned arms, teacher targets, saved-score diagnostics and the decision-bearing fixed-policy shadow were actually executed. This is not a scripts-only result.

Selected-checkpoint strict-solo DEV source-macro balanced accuracy is GT 0.3760860725903099 versus KD 0.37000968370142095; the constant FIT-prior diagnostic is 0.375. These are directional, already-exposed DEV observations, not statistical acceptance thresholds.

On four-speaker ES2009d, both students emit zero confirmed transitions under the frozen decoder, versus nine teacher transitions. The restricted non-overlap word-role proxy has seven reference changes there; teacher matches three at the fixed250ms collar, students zero.

On EN2009d, GT matches the one eligible reference change; KD emits one early event at sample7680 and matches none. Teacher matches one. Unmatched events are unmatched to a restricted proxy, not automatically false acoustic events; overlap exclusions are12 ES and56 EN.

With supported evidence made retrospectively visible, teacher has five applied parents and students one each out of38. Both students have37 absent-raw-candidate parents, not37 receiver-policy rejections. Fixed-policy suppression is therefore not the sole explanation for these outputs. This does not prove a universal acoustic, architectural or KD limitation.

CAL score ranking remains weak: selected-checkpoint per-class conditional AUCs are approximately0.51-0.59 for both arms. Later KD checkpoint780 improves CAL balanced conditional log loss but still has canonical slot2 recall3/139 and slot3 recall0/13. This does not support silently replacing checkpoint selection or launching a calibration/threshold sweep.

The evidence does not isolate a unique objective, representation or data repair. A future learned proposal should first target demonstrable multi-speaker discrimination with preserved multi-active GT and source-local state, rather than tuning the fixed downstream policy to hide missing student evidence. No specific new learned run is justified or released by this record. R5 permits an inconclusive end without automatic extra seeds/data.
